a1b2c3d4e5f6.name: GetTodo
a1b2c3d4e5f6.query: query GetTodo($id: ID!) { todo(id: $id) { id title done items { id content done } createdAt updatedAt } }

f6e5d4c3b2a1.name: GetTodos
f6e5d4c3b2a1.query: query GetTodos($cursor: String, $limit: Int) { todos(cursor: $cursor, limit: $limit) { items { id title done items { id content done } createdAt updatedAt } nextCursor hasMore } }

1a2b3c4d5e6f.name: CreateTodo
1a2b3c4d5e6f.query: mutation CreateTodo($input: CreateTodoInput!) { createTodo(input: $input) { id title done createdAt } }
